Ecology Energy Corporation is a Filipino-owned company that started in 1995 engaging in manufacturing of multi-purpose and specialized greases and bitumen-based products for the automotive, industrial, and construction industry. Additionally, it is also engaged in petroleum waste management.

Our Mission

 EcoOil aims to Fuel The Filipino Drive by uplifting the Filipino spirit through its core values: reliability, quality-service and safety.

 We aim to raise industry standards by fostering livelihood through attainable offerings and promotions.

 Our Vision

 To be the top Filipino-owned petroleum retail brand in the Philippines.

In 2016, Ecology Energy entered the downstream petroleum industry with its retail network across the country, wholesale business serving both commercial and industrial customers and a fuel importation terminal. Ecology Energy Corporation also owns subsidiaries handling end-to-end support services for its main business, including a Singapore-based fuel trading, road transport, marine transport, industrial and non-life insurance. With its highly competent leadership and strategic logistical alliances providing access to fuel depots around the country and its highly integrated logistics capability to support its fast-growing retail network and commercial sales Ecology Energy is poised to become one of the major independent oil companies in the Philippines.
